functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_dispatch_daily_control_v1(p_actor_pin text, p_date date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_role text;
  v_date date := coalesce(p_date, (now() at time zone 'Europe/Belgrade' - interval '4 hours')::date);
  v_start timestamptz;
  v_end timestamptz;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  select upper(coalesce(role,'')) into v_role
  from public.users
  where pin = btrim(coalesce(p_actor_pin,'')) and is_active is true
  limit 1;

  if v_role not in ('DISPATCH','MASTER','MASTER USER','MASTER_USER','MASTERUSER','ADMIN','ADMIN_MASTER','OWNER','PRONAR','SUPERADMIN') then
    raise exception 'DISPATCH_ONLY';
  end if;

  v_start := (v_date::timestamp + interval '4 hours') at time zone 'Europe/Belgrade';
  v_end := ((v_date + 1)::timestamp + interval '4 hours') at time zone 'Europe/Belgrade';

  with
  base_all as (
    select
      o.*,
      public.tepiha_daily_order_m2(o.data, o.m2_total) as calc_m2,
      public.tepiha_daily_order_value(o.data, o.price_total) as calc_value,
      coalesce(o.delivered_at, o."deliveredAt", public.tepiha_daily_try_timestamptz(o.data->>'delivered_at'), public.tepiha_daily_try_timestamptz(o.data->>'picked_up_at')) as out_at,
      upper(coalesce(o.data->>'source','')) as data_source
    from public.orders o
  ),
  base_in as (
    select * from base_all
    where created_at >= v_start and created_at < v_end
      and lower(coalesce(status,'')) not in ('cancelled','canceled')
      and data_source <> 'DB_DRAFT'
  ),
  base_drafts as (
    select * from base_all
    where created_at >= v_start and created_at < v_end
      and (data_source = 'DB_DRAFT' or lower(coalesce(status,'')) in ('draft','pranim'))
  ),
  base_out as (
    select * from base_all where out_at >= v_start and out_at < v_end
  ),
  transport_all as (
    select
      t.*,
      public.tepiha_daily_order_m2(t.data, 0) as calc_m2,
      public.tepiha_daily_order_value(t.data, 0) as calc_value,
      coalesce(
        public.tepiha_daily_try_timestamptz(t.data->>'at_base_at'),
        public.tepiha_daily_try_timestamptz(t.data->>'base_arrived_at'),
        public.tepiha_daily_try_timestamptz(t.data->>'brought_to_base_at'),
        public.tepiha_daily_try_timestamptz(t.data->>'unloaded_at'),
        public.tepiha_daily_try_timestamptz(t.data->>'pastrim_at')
      ) as in_at,
      coalesce(
        public.tepiha_daily_try_timestamptz(t.data->>'done_at'),
        public.tepiha_daily_try_timestamptz(t.data->>'delivered_at'),
        public.tepiha_daily_try_timestamptz(t.data->>'picked_up_at')
      ) as out_at,
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(t.data->>'brought_by_pin',t.data->>'transport_pin',t.data->>'driver_pin','')),'') as worker_pin,
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(t.data->>'brought_by_name',t.data->>'transport_name',t.data->>'driver_name','')),'') as worker_name
    from public.transport_orders t
  ),
  transport_in as (
    select * from transport_all where in_at >= v_start and in_at < v_end
  ),
  transport_out as (
    select * from transport_all where out_at >= v_start and out_at < v_end
  ),
  client_payments as (
    select p.*
    from public.arka_pending_payments p
    where p.created_at >= v_start and p.created_at < v_end
      and upper(coalesce(p.type,'')) in ('IN','TRANSPORT','ORDER')
      and p.amount > 0
  ),
  ledger_day as (
    select l.* from public.company_budget_ledger l
    where l.created_at >= v_start and l.created_at < v_end
  ),
  handoffs_decided as (
    select h.* from public.cash_handoffs h
    where h.decided_at >= v_start and h.decided_at < v_end
  ),
  handoffs_submitted as (
    select h.* from public.cash_handoffs h
    where h.submitted_at >= v_start and h.submitted_at < v_end
  ),
  handoff_checks as (
    select h.id, h.worker_pin, h.worker_name, h.amount,
           coalesce(sum(i.amount),0) as items_amount,
           h.status, h.company_ledger_entry_id, h.submitted_at, h.decided_at
    from public.cash_handoffs h
    left join public.cash_handoff_items i on i.handoff_id=h.id
    where (h.submitted_at >= v_start and h.submitted_at < v_end)
       or (h.decided_at >= v_start and h.decided_at < v_end)
    group by h.id
  ),
  current_base_pastrim as (
    select * from base_all where lower(coalesce(status,'')) in ('pastrim','pastrimi')
  ),
  current_transport_pastrim as (
    select * from transport_all where lower(coalesce(status,'')) in ('pastrim','pastrimi')
  ),
  current_base_gati as (
    select * from base_all where lower(coalesce(status,''))='gati'
  ),
  current_transport_gati as (
    select * from transport_all where lower(coalesce(status,''))='gati'
  ),
  worker_commissions as (
    select
      coalesce(t.worker_pin,'PA PIN') as pin,
      coalesce(max(u.name), max(t.worker_name), 'PA EMER') as name,
      count(*)::int as order_count,
      round(sum(t.calc_m2),2) as m2,
      coalesce(max(u.commission_rate_m2) filter (where u.is_hybrid_transport is true),0) as rate,
      round(sum(t.calc_m2) * coalesce(max(u.commission_rate_m2) filter (where u.is_hybrid_transport is true),0),2) as commission
    from transport_in t
    left join public.users u on u.pin=t.worker_pin and u.is_active is true
    group by coalesce(t.worker_pin,'PA PIN')
  ),
  alert_rows as (
    select 'BASE_DRAFT'::text as code, 'warn'::text as tone,
           count(*)::int as count,
           'Porosi BAZA te mbetura draft/pranim'::text as label,
           jsonb_build_object('m2',round(coalesce(sum(calc_m2),0),2)) as detail
    from base_drafts having count(*)>0
    union all
    select 'BASE_ZERO_M2','bad',count(*)::int,'Hyrje BAZA me 0 m²',jsonb_build_object('ids',jsonb_agg(id))
    from base_in where calc_m2<=0 having count(*)>0
    union all
    select 'TRANSPORT_ZERO_M2','bad',count(*)::int,'Hyrje TRANSPORT me 0 m²',jsonb_build_object('ids',jsonb_agg(id))
    from transport_in where calc_m2<=0 having count(*)>0
    union all
    select 'TRANSPORT_NO_WORKER','bad',count(*)::int,'Hyrje TRANSPORT pa personin qe i solli',jsonb_build_object('codes',jsonb_agg(code_str))
    from transport_in where worker_pin is null and worker_name is null having count(*)>0
    union all
    select 'TRANSPORT_UNKNOWN_WORKER','warn',count(*)::int,'Transportuesi nuk u gjet aktiv ne USERS',jsonb_build_object('pins',jsonb_agg(distinct worker_pin))
    from transport_in t where worker_pin is not null and not exists(select 1 from public.users u where u.pin=t.worker_pin and u.is_active is true) having count(*)>0
    union all
    select 'HANDOFF_MISMATCH','bad',count(*)::int,'Handoff nuk perputhet me shumen e artikujve',jsonb_build_object('handoffs',jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'declared',amount,'items',items_amount)))
    from handoff_checks where abs(amount-items_amount)>0.05 having count(*)>0
    union all
    select 'ACCEPTED_NO_LEDGER','bad',count(*)::int,'Handoff i pranuar pa ledger te kompanise',jsonb_build_object('handoff_ids',jsonb_agg(id))
    from handoff_checks where upper(status) in ('ACCEPTED','ACCEPTED_BY_DISPATCH') and company_ledger_entry_id is null having count(*)>0
    union all
    select 'DUPLICATE_PAYMENT','bad',count(*)::int,'Pagesa te dyfishta per te njejten porosi sot',jsonb_build_object('keys',jsonb_agg(payment_key))
    from (
      select coalesce('B:'||order_id::text,'T:'||transport_order_id::text,'C:'||transport_code_str) as payment_key
      from client_payments
      where order_id is not null or transport_order_id is not null or transport_code_str is not null
      group by coalesce('B:'||order_id::text,'T:'||transport_order_id::text,'C:'||transport_code_str)
      having count(*)>1
    ) d having count(*)>0
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'version','dispatch-daily-control-v1',
    'date',v_date,
    'timezone','Europe/Belgrade',
    'generated_at',now(),
    'operations',jsonb_build_object(
      'incoming',jsonb_build_object(
        'base',jsonb_build_object(
          'count',(select count(*) from base_in),
          'm2',(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_m2),0),2) from base_in),
          'value',(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_value),0),2) from base_in),
          'rows',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'code',code,'client',client_name,'m2',calc_m2,'value',calc_value,'status',status,'at',created_at) order by created_at desc),'[]'::jsonb) from base_in)
        ),
        'transport',jsonb_build_object(
          'count',(select count(*) from transport_in),
          'm2',(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_m2),0),2) from transport_in),
          'value',(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_value),0),2) from transport_in),
          'rows',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'code',code_str,'client',client_name,'m2',calc_m2,'value',calc_value,'status',status,'at',in_at,'worker_pin',worker_pin,'worker_name',worker_name) order by in_at desc),'[]'::jsonb) from transport_in)
        ),
        'total',jsonb_build_object(
          'count',(select count(*) from base_in)+(select count(*) from transport_in),
          'm2',(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_m2),0),2) from base_in)+(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_m2),0),2) from transport_in),
          'value',(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_value),0),2) from base_in)+(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_value),0),2) from transport_in)
        )
      ),
      'outgoing',jsonb_build_object(
        'base',jsonb_build_object(
          'count',(select count(*) from base_out),
          'm2',(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_m2),0),2) from base_out),
          'value',(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_value),0),2) from base_out),
          'rows',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'code',code,'client',client_name,'m2',calc_m2,'value',calc_value,'status',status,'at',out_at) order by out_at desc),'[]'::jsonb) from base_out)
        ),
        'transport',jsonb_build_object(
          'count',(select count(*) from transport_out),
          'm2',(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_m2),0),2) from transport_out),
          'value',(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_value),0),2) from transport_out),
          'rows',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'code',code_str,'client',client_name,'m2',calc_m2,'value',calc_value,'status',status,'at',out_at,'worker_pin',worker_pin,'worker_name',worker_name) order by out_at desc),'[]'::jsonb) from transport_out)
        ),
        'total',jsonb_build_object(
          'count',(select count(*) from base_out)+(select count(*) from transport_out),
          'm2',(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_m2),0),2) from base_out)+(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_m2),0),2) from transport_out),
          'value',(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_value),0),2) from base_out)+(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_value),0),2) from transport_out)
        )
      ),
      'net_m2',((select round(coalesce(sum(calc_m2),0),2) from base_in)+(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_m2),0),2) from transport_in))-((select round(coalesce(sum(calc_m2),0),2) from base_out)+(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_m2),0),2) from transport_out)),
      'current',jsonb_build_object(
        'pastrim',jsonb_build_object('count',(select count(*) from current_base_pastrim)+(select count(*) from current_transport_pastrim),'m2',(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_m2),0),2) from current_base_pastrim)+(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_m2),0),2) from current_transport_pastrim)),
        'gati',jsonb_build_object('count',(select count(*) from current_base_gati)+(select count(*) from current_transport_gati),'m2',(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_m2),0),2) from current_base_gati)+(select round(coalesce(sum(calc_m2),0),2) from current_transport_gati))
      )
    ),
    'arka',jsonb_build_object(
      'client_cash',jsonb_build_object(
        'count',(select count(*) from client_payments),
        'gross',(select round(coalesce(sum(amount),0),2) from client_payments),
        'base',(select round(coalesce(sum(amount),0),2) from client_payments where upper(coalesce(source_module,''))='BASE'),
        'transport',(select round(coalesce(sum(amount),0),2) from client_payments where upper(coalesce(source_module,''))='TRANSPORT'),
        'pending',(select round(coalesce(sum(amount),0),2) from client_payments where upper(status)='PENDING'),
        'collected',(select round(coalesce(sum(amount),0),2) from client_payments where upper(status)='COLLECTED'),
        'accepted',(select round(coalesce(sum(amount),0),2) from client_payments where upper(status) in ('ACCEPTED','ACCEPTED_BY_DISPATCH')),
        'rows',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'amount',amount,'type',type,'status',status,'source',source_module,'code',coalesce(transport_code_str,order_code::text),'client',client_name,'worker_pin',created_by_pin,'worker_name',created_by_name,'m2',transport_m2,'at',created_at) order by created_at desc),'[]'::jsonb) from client_payments)
      ),
      'ledger',jsonb_build_object(
        'in',(select round(coalesce(sum(amount),0),2) from ledger_day where upper(direction)='IN'),
        'out',(select round(coalesce(sum(amount),0),2) from ledger_day where upper(direction)='OUT'),
        'net',(select round(coalesce(sum(case when upper(direction)='IN' then amount else -amount end),0),2) from ledger_day),
        'balance',(select round(coalesce(sum(case when upper(direction)='IN' then amount else -amount end),0),2) from public.company_budget_ledger),
        'rows',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'direction',direction,'amount',amount,'category',category,'description',description,'source_type',source_type,'source_id',source_id,'at',created_at) order by created_at desc),'[]'::jsonb) from ledger_day)
      ),
      'handoffs',jsonb_build_object(
        'submitted_count',(select count(*) from handoffs_submitted),
        'submitted_amount',(select round(coalesce(sum(amount),0),2) from handoffs_submitted),
        'accepted_count',(select count(*) from handoffs_decided where upper(status) in ('ACCEPTED','ACCEPTED_BY_DISPATCH')),
        'accepted_amount',(select round(coalesce(sum(amount),0),2) from handoffs_decided where upper(status) in ('ACCEPTED','ACCEPTED_BY_DISPATCH')),
        'pending_now_count',(select count(*) from public.cash_handoffs where upper(status) in ('PENDING','PENDING_DISPATCH_APPROVAL')),
        'pending_now_amount',(select round(coalesce(sum(amount),0),2) from public.cash_handoffs where upper(status) in ('PENDING','PENDING_DISPATCH_APPROVAL'))
      ),
      'open_cash',jsonb_build_object(
        'count',(select count(*) from public.arka_pending_payments where upper(status) in ('PENDING','COLLECTED','PENDING_DISPATCH_APPROVAL') and upper(coalesce(type,'')) in ('IN','TRANSPORT','ORDER')),
        'amount',(select round(coalesce(sum(amount),0),2) from public.arka_pending_payments where upper(status) in ('PENDING','COLLECTED','PENDING_DISPATCH_APPROVAL') and upper(coalesce(type,'')) in ('IN','TRANSPORT','ORDER')),
        'old_count',(select count(*) from public.arka_pending_payments where created_at<v_start and upper(status) in ('PENDING','COLLECTED','PENDING_DISPATCH_APPROVAL') and upper(coalesce(type,'')) in ('IN','TRANSPORT','ORDER')),
        'old_amount',(select round(coalesce(sum(amount),0),2) from public.arka_pending_payments where created_at<v_start and upper(status) in ('PENDING','COLLECTED','PENDING_DISPATCH_APPROVAL') and upper(coalesce(type,'')) in ('IN','TRANSPORT','ORDER'))
      ),
      'pending_expenses',jsonb_build_object(
        'count',(select count(*) from public.arka_pending_payments where upper(type)='EXPENSE' and upper(status) in ('PENDING','PENDING_DISPATCH_APPROVAL')),
        'amount',(select round(coalesce(sum(amount),0),2) from public.arka_pending_payments where upper(type)='EXPENSE' and upper(status) in ('PENDING','PENDING_DISPATCH_APPROVAL'))
      )
    ),
    'commissions',jsonb_build_object(
      'total',(select round(coalesce(sum(commission),0),2) from worker_commissions),
      'workers',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('pin',pin,'name',name,'orders',order_count,'m2',m2,'rate',rate,'commission',commission) order by name),'[]'::jsonb) from worker_commissions)
    ),
    'alerts',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('code',code,'tone',tone,'count',count,'label',label,'detail',detail)),'[]'::jsonb) from alert_rows)
  ) into v_result;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

functions.name: get_worker_compensation_profile_v1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_worker_compensation_profile_v1(p_actor_pin text, p_worker_pin text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor_role text;
  v_worker public.users%rowtype;
begin
  select upper(coalesce(role,'')) into v_actor_role
  from public.users
  where pin=trim(coalesce(p_actor_pin,'')) and is_active is true
  limit 1;

  if trim(coalesce(p_actor_pin,'')) <> trim(coalesce(p_worker_pin,''))
     and v_actor_role not in ('ADMIN','ADMIN_MASTER','DISPATCH','OWNER','PRONAR','SUPERADMIN','MASTER','MASTER_USER','MASTERUSER') then
    raise exception 'WORKER_FINANCE_ACCESS_DENIED';
  end if;

  select * into v_worker
  from public.users
  where pin=trim(coalesce(p_worker_pin,'')) and is_active is true
  limit 1;
  if not found then raise exception 'WORKER_NOT_FOUND:%',p_worker_pin; end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'pin',v_worker.pin,
    'name',v_worker.name,
    'role',v_worker.role,
    'active',v_worker.is_active,
    'salary_enabled',v_worker.pay_salary_enabled,
    'salary_amount',round(coalesce(v_worker.salary,0)::numeric,2),
    'salary_day',v_worker.salary_day,
    'meal_enabled',v_worker.pay_meal_enabled,
    'meal_amount',round(coalesce(v_worker.pay_meal_amount,0)::numeric,2),
    'commission_enabled',v_worker.pay_commission_enabled,
    'commission_rate_m2',round(coalesce(v_worker.pay_commission_rate_m2,0)::numeric,4),
    'transport_bonus_enabled',v_worker.pay_transport_bonus_enabled,
    'transport_bonus_amount',round(coalesce(v_worker.pay_transport_bonus_amount,0)::numeric,2),
    'ready_bonus_enabled',v_worker.pay_ready_bonus_enabled,
    'cash_mode',v_worker.pay_cash_mode,
    'notes',v_worker.pay_notes,
    'updated_at',v_worker.pay_updated_at,
    'updated_by_pin',v_worker.pay_updated_by_pin,
    'updated_by_name',v_worker.pay_updated_by_name
  );
end;
$function$

functions.name: get_worker_finance_snapshot_v1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_worker_finance_snapshot_v1(p_actor_pin text, p_worker_pin text, p_date date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor_role text;
  v_worker public.users%rowtype;
  v_date date := coalesce(p_date,(now() at time zone 'Europe/Belgrade')::date);
  v_start timestamptz := v_date::timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Belgrade';
  v_end timestamptz := (v_date+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Belgrade';
  v_month_start timestamptz := date_trunc('month',v_date::timestamp)::timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Belgrade';
  v_month_end timestamptz := (date_trunc('month',v_date::timestamp)+interval '1 month')::timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Belgrade';
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  select upper(coalesce(role,'')) into v_actor_role
  from public.users
  where pin=trim(coalesce(p_actor_pin,'')) and is_active is true
  limit 1;

  if trim(coalesce(p_actor_pin,'')) <> trim(coalesce(p_worker_pin,''))
     and v_actor_role not in ('ADMIN','ADMIN_MASTER','DISPATCH','OWNER','PRONAR','SUPERADMIN','MASTER','MASTER_USER','MASTERUSER') then
    raise exception 'WORKER_FINANCE_ACCESS_DENIED';
  end if;

  select * into v_worker
  from public.users
  where pin=trim(coalesce(p_worker_pin,'')) and is_active is true
  limit 1;
  if not found then raise exception 'WORKER_NOT_FOUND:%',p_worker_pin; end if;

  with all_real as (
    select p.*,
      case when upper(coalesce(p.source_module,''))='TRANSPORT'
                 or upper(coalesce(p.type,''))='TRANSPORT'
                 or p.transport_order_id is not null
                 or upper(coalesce(p.transport_code_str,'')) ~ '^T[0-9]+$'
           then true else false end as is_transport
    from public.arka_pending_payments p
    where p.created_by_pin=v_worker.pin
      and upper(coalesce(p.type,'')) not in ('EXPENSE','TIMA','MEAL_PAYMENT','MEAL_COVERED','READY_48H_BONUS','ADVANCE','SALARY_PAYMENT')
      and not exists(
        select 1 from public.arka_payment_exclusions e
        where e.payment_id=p.id and e.cancelled_at is null
      )
  ), calc as (
    select r.*,
      case when v_worker.pay_commission_enabled is true
                 and v_worker.pay_cash_mode='HYBRID_COMMISSION'
                 and r.is_transport
           then least(round(r.amount::numeric,2),round((coalesce(r.transport_m2,0)*coalesce(v_worker.pay_commission_rate_m2,0))::numeric,2))
           else 0::numeric end as commission,
      (r.created_at at time zone 'Europe/Belgrade')::date as local_date
    from all_real r
  ), money_rows as (
    select c.*,
      round((round(c.amount::numeric,2)-round(c.commission::numeric,2))::numeric,2) as due_to_base
    from calc c
  ), open_rows as (
    select * from money_rows where upper(coalesce(status,'')) in ('PENDING','COLLECTED')
  ), accepted_rows as (
    select * from money_rows where upper(coalesce(status,'')) in ('ACCEPTED_BY_DISPATCH','APPROVED','ACCEPTED')
  ), extra_rows as (
    select p.*,(p.created_at at time zone 'Europe/Belgrade')::date local_date
    from public.arka_pending_payments p
    where (p.created_by_pin=v_worker.pin or p.handed_by_pin=v_worker.pin)
      and upper(coalesce(p.type,'')) in ('EXPENSE','MEAL_PAYMENT','MEAL_COVERED','TIMA')
      and upper(coalesce(p.status,'')) not in ('REJECTED','REFUZUAR','CANCELLED','CANCELED','VOIDED')
  ), active_advances as (
    select p.*
    from public.arka_pending_payments p
    where p.created_by_pin=v_worker.pin
      and (upper(coalesce(p.type,''))='ADVANCE' or upper(coalesce(p.status,''))='ADVANCE')
      and upper(coalesce(p.status,'')) not in ('SETTLED_IN_SALARY','CANCELLED','CANCELED','VOIDED')
  ), pending_handoffs as (
    select h.* from public.cash_handoffs h
    where h.worker_pin=v_worker.pin and upper(coalesce(h.status,''))='PENDING_DISPATCH_APPROVAL'
  ), accepted_handoffs as (
    select h.* from public.cash_handoffs h
    where h.worker_pin=v_worker.pin and upper(coalesce(h.status,''))='ACCEPTED'
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'version','WORKER_FINANCE_SNAPSHOT_V1',
    'date',v_date,
    'generated_at',now(),
    'actor',jsonb_build_object('pin',trim(p_actor_pin),'role',v_actor_role,'can_manage',v_actor_role in ('ADMIN','ADMIN_MASTER','DISPATCH','OWNER','PRONAR','SUPERADMIN','MASTER','MASTER_USER','MASTERUSER')),
    'worker',jsonb_build_object('id',v_worker.id,'pin',v_worker.pin,'name',v_worker.name,'role',v_worker.role,'active',v_worker.is_active),
    'profile',public.get_worker_compensation_profile_v1(p_actor_pin,p_worker_pin),
    'cash',jsonb_build_object(
      'open_gross',coalesce((select round(sum(amount)::numeric,2) from open_rows),0),
      'open_commission',coalesce((select round(sum(commission)::numeric,2) from open_rows),0),
      'open_due_to_base',coalesce((select round(sum(due_to_base)::numeric,2) from open_rows),0),
      'open_count',(select count(*) from open_rows),
      'today_gross',coalesce((select round(sum(amount)::numeric,2) from open_rows where local_date=v_date),0),
      'today_commission',coalesce((select round(sum(commission)::numeric,2) from open_rows where local_date=v_date),0),
      'today_due_to_base',coalesce((select round(sum(due_to_base)::numeric,2) from open_rows where local_date=v_date),0),
      'today_count',(select count(*) from open_rows where local_date=v_date),
      'carryover_gross',coalesce((select round(sum(amount)::numeric,2) from open_rows where local_date<v_date),0),
      'carryover_commission',coalesce((select round(sum(commission)::numeric,2) from open_rows where local_date<v_date),0),
      'carryover_due_to_base',coalesce((select round(sum(due_to_base)::numeric,2) from open_rows where local_date<v_date),0),
      'carryover_count',(select count(*) from open_rows where local_date<v_date),
      'accepted_month_gross',coalesce((select round(sum(amount)::numeric,2) from accepted_rows where created_at>=v_month_start and created_at<v_month_end),0),
      'accepted_month_commission',coalesce((select round(sum(commission)::numeric,2) from accepted_rows where created_at>=v_month_start and created_at<v_month_end),0),
      'accepted_month_due_to_base',coalesce((select round(sum(due_to_base)::numeric,2) from accepted_rows where created_at>=v_month_start and created_at<v_month_end),0),
      'pending_handoff_total',coalesce((select round(sum(amount)::numeric,2) from pending_handoffs),0),
      'pending_handoff_count',(select count(*) from pending_handoffs),
      'accepted_handoff_today',coalesce((select round(sum(amount)::numeric,2) from accepted_handoffs where decided_at>=v_start and decided_at<v_end),0),
      'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id',id,'code',coalesce(transport_code_str,case when order_code is not null then order_code::text else null end),
        'client_name',client_name,'amount',round(amount::numeric,2),'commission',round(commission::numeric,2),
        'due_to_base',round(due_to_base::numeric,2),'m2',round(coalesce(transport_m2,0)::numeric,2),
        'status',status,'type',type,'source_module',source_module,'created_at',created_at,'local_date',local_date
      ) order by created_at desc,id desc) from open_rows),'[]'::jsonb),
      'accepted_rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id',id,'code',coalesce(transport_code_str,case when order_code is not null then order_code::text else null end),
        'client_name',client_name,'amount',round(amount::numeric,2),'commission',round(commission::numeric,2),
        'due_to_base',round(due_to_base::numeric,2),'status',status,'created_at',created_at
      ) order by created_at desc,id desc) from (select * from accepted_rows order by created_at desc,id desc limit 30) a),'[]'::jsonb)
    ),
    'expenses',jsonb_build_object(
      'today_total',coalesce((select round(sum(amount)::numeric,2) from extra_rows where local_date=v_date and upper(type) in ('EXPENSE','MEAL_PAYMENT','MEAL_COVERED')),0),
      'today_pending',coalesce((select round(sum(amount)::numeric,2) from extra_rows where local_date=v_date and upper(status) in ('PENDING','COLLECTED','PENDING_DISPATCH_APPROVAL')),0),
      'today_accepted',coalesce((select round(sum(amount)::numeric,2) from extra_rows where local_date=v_date and upper(status) in ('ACCEPTED_BY_DISPATCH','APPROVED','ACCEPTED')),0),
      'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'type',type,'status',status,'amount',round(amount::numeric,2),'note',note,'created_at',created_at) order by created_at desc,id desc) from extra_rows where local_date=v_date),'[]'::jsonb)
    ),
    'advances',jsonb_build_object(
      'active_total',coalesce((select round(sum(amount)::numeric,2) from active_advances),0),
      'active_count',(select count(*) from active_advances),
      'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'amount',round(amount::numeric,2),'note',note,'status',status,'created_at',created_at) order by created_at desc,id desc) from active_advances),'[]'::jsonb)
    ),
    'payroll',jsonb_build_object(
      'salary',case when v_worker.pay_salary_enabled then round(coalesce(v_worker.salary,0)::numeric,2) else 0 end,
      'meal_bonus',case when v_worker.pay_meal_enabled then round(coalesce(v_worker.pay_meal_amount,0)::numeric,2) else 0 end,
      'transport_bonus',case when v_worker.pay_transport_bonus_enabled then round(coalesce(v_worker.pay_transport_bonus_amount,0)::numeric,2) else 0 end,
      'commission_retained_month',case when v_worker.pay_commission_enabled and v_worker.pay_cash_mode='HYBRID_COMMISSION' then coalesce((select round(sum(commission)::numeric,2) from money_rows where created_at>=v_month_start and created_at<v_month_end),0) else 0 end,
      'advances_active',coalesce((select round(sum(amount)::numeric,2) from active_advances),0),
      'gross_fixed',round((
        case when v_worker.pay_salary_enabled then coalesce(v_worker.salary,0) else 0 end +
        case when v_worker.pay_meal_enabled then coalesce(v_worker.pay_meal_amount,0) else 0 end +
        case when v_worker.pay_transport_bonus_enabled then coalesce(v_worker.pay_transport_bonus_amount,0) else 0 end
      )::numeric,2),
      'net_fixed_after_advances',greatest(0,round((
        case when v_worker.pay_salary_enabled then coalesce(v_worker.salary,0) else 0 end +
        case when v_worker.pay_meal_enabled then coalesce(v_worker.pay_meal_amount,0) else 0 end +
        case when v_worker.pay_transport_bonus_enabled then coalesce(v_worker.pay_transport_bonus_amount,0) else 0 end -
        coalesce((select sum(amount) from active_advances),0)
      )::numeric,2)),
      'salary_day',v_worker.salary_day
    )
  ) into v_result;

  return v_result;
end;
